name: team_planning_set_actual_pay
description: Hold a person's actual pay in a scenario of a Team Planning plan, so cost prices their seat from it for members with the see-pay right; everyone else still sees band midpoints. The amount is base pay, and cost adds the unit's on-cost on top. basis says what the amount is: full_time for a full-time figure that the person's FTE scales, or actual for what they are paid as it is, already pro-rated, which FTE leaves alone. period is year, month or hour; an hourly amount is a rate, made yearly by the working_hours rule, so its basis is always full_time. The plan keeps it private to that person, so once they are forgotten it reads as unknown and their seat goes unpriced. Clear it with team_planning_clear_change on facet data:pay. Refused unless the caller is one of the plan's editors and holds the see-pay right. `note` is Markdown: links, **bold**, _italic_, lists and `code` render, a bare URL becomes a link, typed HTML shows as text and images render as links.

note.description: Why this is in the plan, such as the business reason for a move. Optional, at most 2000 characters; it never changes what the scenario resolves to. A note on a change to a person goes when they are forgotten. Any other note, such as one on a unit, a position or a rule, stays until the plan is deleted, so keep personal details out of it.

scenario_id.description: The scenario, or the plan's id for the baseline.

amount.description: Base pay for one period, such as "92000" or "48.50".

currency.description: An ISO 4217 code, such as AUD.
